The directory rule is its siblings': the record is not edited to stay current, and a claim the tree has since REFUTED carries a `superseded_by` object — note · devlog · date · why — as the first key of the object holding it. `python scripts/spec/audit_evidence_supersession.py --check` is the gate.
_comment: GAP burn-down series for the COBOL.NET Conformance Ledger artifact, appended by scripts/spec/gen_ledger.py. ONE POINT PER BATTERY OR GAP-MOVING LANDING - a commit that moves no row adds no point, or this becomes a commit log with a y-axis. Every field is MEASURED, never remembered: each point's gap/closed/dns were read out of that commit's own tests/version-matrix/traceability-inventory.json (git show <sha>:<path>), which is why the series can be re-derived by anyone who doubts it. `battery` carries the battery number when the point is the tree a comprehensive run was measured on, and null otherwise; the chart marks that point, because a burn-down without its last gate on it invites the reader to trust an ungated number. `label` is a short chart caption for the first point only - the rest are dated. Since 2026-10-10 (kb/Work PB2912) each point also carries the REGISTER series, measured from the same commit's own kb/Work frontmatter and inventory: compiler_open (open notes that are not process_only), defects (of them kind: defect), wrong_answer, crashes, and gap_holders (open notes whose inventory_rows hold a GAP row; null where that tree's notes carried no inventory_rows yet); a point is appended when the inventory OR the register series moves. The 173 points recorded before then gained those five fields by gen_ledger.py --backfill-register, each from its own sha; no recorded value was changed. The program list (the re-architecture program, 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08) is frozen history: the program is held (kb/Work PB2911) and nothing appends to it. This file is DATA for a derived view; it is not a work list and must never grow one (CLAUDE.md rule 8). Seeded 2026-09-02 from the five landings that moved the inventory since the 2026-08-29 phase-B batch; earlier history is in DEVLOG.md and is recoverable the same way.
